title: Group log: optional verification_cid in log entry + attestation block
description:
Add shared-if-easy gossip of verification results via an optional CID in the group log entry.

What: crates/core/src/group_log.rs (LogEntry schema); crates/verify/src/attestation.rs

LogEntry gains one optional field:
  pub verification_cid: Option<Cid>   // DAG-CBOR attestation block; None if verification not performed

Attestation block schema (DAG-CBOR, written to IPFS by the verifying node):
  {
    'article': CID,
    'ts': u64,
    'verifier': String,   // 'did:key:...' or node key fingerprint
    'checks': [
      { 'type': 'usenet-ipfs-sig', 'key_id': String, 'result': String },
      { 'type': 'dkim', 'key_id': String, 'result': String, 'detail': String },
    ]
  }

Algorithm:
1. After verify_article() runs, serialize checks to DAG-CBOR, write block to IpfsStore, get CID.
2. Set log_entry.verification_cid = Some(attestation_cid).
3. Peers receiving the log entry can optionally fetch the attestation block (best-effort, not required).
4. If IpfsStore write fails: log warn, set verification_cid = None, continue (non-fatal).

DAG-CBOR serialization: use serde_ipld_dagcbor (already in tree).
This field is optional in both directions: old peers ignore it; new peers populate it when they can.

Defensive rules:
- LogEntry DAG-CBOR must remain backward-compatible: optional field with default None.
- Attestation block write failure must never block log entry commit.
